attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Accredited college academic courses (1 credit = 15 hours) and workshops, seminars, conferences, lectures and agency staff development by Board-approved continuing education sponsors; programs must relate to social work practice. Procedural/administrative agency training not eligible.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal; a certificate of completion of 30 hours from the previous two-year license period accompanies the renewal. Max 10 hours from self/group study (tapes, reading) or preparing/publishing papers. Biennial fees: CSW-PIP $210, CSW $170, SW $130, SWA $90.
